name: HANJIN Logistics Corporation
summary: HANJIN Logistics Corporation provides transportation and logistics services in South Korea and internationally. The company provides inland transportation services; and stevedoring services for cargoes, including containers, industrial goods, automobiles, heavy cargoes, grains, steel products, iron ore coal, and transported goods. It also offers marine transport services for steel products, general cargo, heavy cargo, and radioactive waste products; warehousing, air and sea forwarding, packaging moving, express, and small package delivery services; and maintenance services for logistics.
